text_block_list.text:
Oh, huh!? When did you get back……?! 
……―No, that's not it!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
H-hmph! 
That instructor put you up to this, huh?!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди
choice_data_list: No, I want to know more about you
No, I want to know more about you

text_block_list.text:
I had misunderstood her because I didn't know anything 
about Шинко Винди. When I think about it, I never 
properly spoke with her even once.
You can't fool me, you probably――…… huh?
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: ……You want to know more about Windy-chan?
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
…………Hmmmmm. 
……Well, if you're that desperate.
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: All of it!?
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Shi shi shi! You're such a hopeless person! 
Then you better listen up, to the saga of Windy-chan!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: Ever since she was born, Windy-chan has always been amazing!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
My dad and my mom, and all the employees 
at our company, everyone would praise Windy-chan!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Windy-chan! How can you eat those sweets 
in such a cute way!? You must be a genius～!
text_block_list.name: Windy's Mom

text_block_list.text:
Ha Ha Ha, Windy is always lively and running around! 
You're a world-class treasure!
text_block_list.name: Windy's Dad

text_block_list.text:
But…… in kindergarten I found out…… 
that this world, is really strange!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
It's strange! When I'm eating food, waking up after a nap, 
or putting on my shoes, nobody praises me!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: No matter what I do, nobody will look at me!!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Isn't that normal? I held back from saying those words…… 
I decided to stay quiet and keep listening.

No matter how I think about it, it's really weird! Even though 
Windy-chan is the number one existence in this world……
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
That's why, since I had no choice, I had to stand out on my own! 
Watching their reactions, trying all kinds of things, and then――
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Surprising everyone, and being the focus of attention! 
The ultimate existence that even heroes would chase after!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: Gaooo-! So I decided to become a devilish fiend!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
As I thought, Шинко Винди's reasons for causing mischief were 
『I want to stand out』 and 『I want to be the focus of attention』.

I really really went wild, and the pranks were really fun! 
……but, I realized that that alone wasn't enough.
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
If it's just pranks, then everyone gets bored really 
fast. If I want them to focus on me much, much, 
muuuuuch longer, it's not good enough!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
That's why I went around to a lot of places…… 
and went to a place where there was a lot of cheering!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
And she crosses the goal first! 
She managed to claim a brilliant victory!
text_block_list.name: Announcer

text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaahー!)

A-amazing, everyone, everyone, eeeeeveryone! 
Is only…… focusing on them!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
That's the place that Windy-chan belongs! 
It's shiny! The cheers are so loud!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
That's why, Windy-chan is going to enter the Twinkle Series! 
To become the most amazing Uma Musume there!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
……Hmph! This place is strange! 
Compared to before, there are less people watching me!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
………… 
Fast ones, strong ones, amazing ones.
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Of course, Windy-chan is more amazing than them! 
But, but…… they're…… pretty amazing too.
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: …………I didn't know about anyone like that.
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
……～～～ annoying! Annoying! Annoying!! 
I-if it's like this……!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: Then someone like Windy-chan is……!!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
……Tracen Academy is a school where geniuses gather. 
It's a place that shatters the hearts of Uma Musume 
that have confidence in themselves.

It's something that will slowly whittle away at you until it's 
too late. The escalation of her pranks was a call for help――

That's why I've decided! 
I'm quitting!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: Before I realized it, I grabbed her arm.

Even though I had misunderstood…… it was undeniable that her 
pranks were a result of her desire for attention.

If she could strengthen herself through training, 
then her results would be different. That things 
had gotten this bad was partially my fault.

It's not like she's lacking in talent. If things go well, 
then she should be able to run happily again. I wondered if I 
could help her with that――
W-……what's with you? You don't want Windy-chan to quit?
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: With that response, I saw an opportunity.
Wha――
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: What are you saying all of a sudden――
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to your future!

text_block_list.text: ……Fufu, Kuu kuu kuu kuu!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Waa ha ha ha ha ha ha! 
Waa ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
That's right, that's right, that's right! 
Windy-chan is amazing, cool, and the best and strongest!!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: That's why, in the next race, for sure……!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: Fufuun, you got that right!!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди
